Extract any installed Android app as an APK, back it up, and share it. Split apps from the Play Store are merged into one APK that installs anywhere.

## Features

- **Extract any app.** Installed and system apps, one at a time or several at once.
- **APK or APKS for split apps.** Apps delivered as split APKs (most Play Store apps) can be merged into a single installable APK, re-signed on your device, or kept as an `.apks` bundle with the original signature. Choose for each app, or set a default.
- **Built-in installer.** Install `.apk`, `.apks`, `.xapk` and `.apkm` files from the Install tab, or share or open them with the app from any file manager. Split bundles install in one go, with no extra installer app.
- **Open or share right away.** After extracting, jump straight to the folder or share the file. The History tab keeps every extraction so you can find it again later.
- **Search, sort and filter.** Find apps by name or package, sorted by name, size, install or update date.
- **Your look.** Light and dark themes, a pure black option, and nine accent colours or your own hex colour.
- Saves to `Download/APK Extractor` or any folder you pick. No internet permission, no ads, no tracking. About 1.5 MB.

## Download

Get **`apk-extractor-v1.0.0.apk`**. Requires Android 7.0 or newer. Android may offer to scan the app before installing, because it doesn't come from the Play Store. Tap "Scan app" and it will install normally.

A merged APK is signed with a key made on your device, so uninstall the original app before installing it. Some apps may not open after being merged; save those as APKS instead.
